title: Improve Your Listening Skills By Transcribing
summary: 通过听写训练提升英语听力能力，学习如何利用转录方法强化对英语声音和文本之间对应关系的理解。

sentences.english: English learners can improve their listening skills by transcribing spoken English.
sentences.chinese: 英语学习者可以通过听写英语口语内容来提高听力能力。

sentences.english: That advice comes from Pascal Hamon, the Academic Director for the English Language Institute.
sentences.chinese: 这个建议来自 Pascal Hamon，他是英语语言学院的学术主任。
该学院位于密苏里州立大学。

sentences.english: Students often study listening comprehension in less than interesting, even boring ways. Transcription, however, provides a fun way to improve one's listening skills.
sentences.chinese: 学生经常用不太有趣甚至枯燥的方法学习听力理解。然而，听写提供了一种有趣的方式来提升听力能力。

sentences.english: At VOA Learning English, we often receive questions from English learners about how they can improve their listening skills.
sentences.chinese: 在 VOA Learning English，我们经常收到英语学习者关于如何提高听力的问题。

sentences.english: Some learners want to build up general English skills, while others want to take exams that involve listening skills.
sentences.chinese: 一些学习者希望提升整体英语能力，而另一些学习者希望参加包含听力测试的考试。
